title: Your turn, phase by phase
summary: Beginning, first main, combat, second main, ending. Same order, every turn.

checklist.label: I know the five phases in order
I know untap, upkeep and draw
I know what I can do in a main phase
I know what happens in the ending phase

steps.title: Five phases, every turn
steps.body:
Every turn follows the same five [[phase|phases]], always in this order:

- Beginning
- First [[main-phase|main phase]]
- Combat
- Second main phase
- Ending

A memory trick: **wake up, build, fight, build again, wind down**.

visual.altText: The five phases of a turn in order.

check.question: Which phase comes right after combat?

steps.title: Phase 1: Beginning
steps.body:
The beginning phase has three [[turn-step|steps]]:

- **Untap:** [[untap]] all your tapped cards.
- **Upkeep:** anything that says "at the beginning of your upkeep" happens now.
- **Draw:** draw one card.

You can't play lands or creatures in this phase.

visual.altText: The untap, upkeep and draw steps.

steps.title: Phase 2: First main phase
steps.body:
This is your building time. You can:

- Play one [[land]], if you haven't this turn.
- Cast creatures, sorceries, artifacts, enchantments and planeswalkers.
- Cast instants, as you can at most times.

You don't have to do anything. You can also go straight to combat.

visual.altText: Playing a land and casting a creature in the main phase.

steps.title: Phase 3: Combat
steps.body:
Combat is where creatures fight. In short:

- You choose which creatures [[attack]].
- Your opponent chooses which creatures [[block]].
- Damage happens.

Attacking is always optional. Module 8 covers combat step by step.

visual.altText: Creatures attacking and one being blocked.

steps.title: Phase 4: Second main phase
steps.body:
After combat you get another main phase. It works just like the first one.

Many players cast creatures here instead of before combat. That way, the opponent doesn't know about them while deciding how to block.

If you didn't play a land earlier this turn, you can play it now.

check.question: You played a land before combat. Can you play another one in your second main phase?

options.text: No, it's one land per turn

check.hint: The second main phase is part of the same turn.

steps.title: Phase 5: Ending
steps.body:
The ending phase has two steps:

- **End step:** anything that says "at the beginning of the end step" happens.
- **Cleanup:** if you have more than seven cards in hand, discard down to seven. Then [[damage]] on creatures wears off, and effects that last "until end of turn" end.

Then the next player's turn begins.

visual.altText: Cleanup: damage wears off and the hand goes down to seven.

check.question: A creature took 2 damage in combat and survived. What happens to that damage?

options.text: It stays on the creature forever
It wears off in the cleanup step
It moves to my life total
